answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in tide, verified in lotus, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the zenith check. A farm of 794 identities would post 3831 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
